points.title: Burst start in mode 0 (CPOL=0,CPHA=0)
points.condition: Command handshake while o_cs_n=1 with i_cpol=0 and i_cpha=0.

points.title: Burst start in mode 1 (CPOL=0,CPHA=1)
points.condition: Command handshake while o_cs_n=1 with i_cpol=0 and i_cpha=1.

points.title: Burst start in mode 2 (CPOL=1,CPHA=0)
points.condition: Command handshake while o_cs_n=1 with i_cpol=1 and i_cpha=0.

points.title: Burst start in mode 3 (CPOL=1,CPHA=1)
points.condition: Command handshake while o_cs_n=1 with i_cpol=1 and i_cpha=1.

points.title: Mode inputs changed in the cycle before burst-start acceptance
points.condition: Burst-start handshake where i_cpol or i_cpha differs from its value one clock earlier.

points.title: Mode inputs differ from captured mode during a burst (error test)
points.condition: o_cs_n=0 and i_cpol or i_cpha differs from the value captured at burst start.

points.title: i_cpol toggled in Idle with o_sclk following
points.condition: o_cs_n=1, i_cpol changed since the previous clock and o_sclk equals i_cpol.

points.title: i_cmd_last=1 on the first byte of a burst
points.condition: Burst-start handshake with i_cmd_last=1.

points.title: Burst of length 1 completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had exactly 1 byte.

points.title: Burst of length 2 completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had exactly 2 bytes.

points.title: Burst of length 3 to 15 completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had 3 to 15 bytes.

points.title: Burst of length 16 completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had exactly 16 bytes.

points.title: Burst of length 17 to 31 completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had 17 to 31 bytes.

points.title: Long burst of 32 or more bytes completed
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen and the finished burst had 32 or more bytes (counter saturates at 255).

points.title: No-gap joint into a continuing transfer
points.condition: Command handshake with o_cs_n=0 and o_sclk different from the captured CPOL_b (last cycle of a transfer) and i_cmd_last=0.

points.title: Joint handshake carrying i_cmd_last=1
points.condition: Joint handshake (o_cs_n=0, o_sclk not CPOL_b) with i_cmd_last=1.

points.title: Pause entered
points.condition: First cycle of a Pause: o_cs_n=0, o_sclk at CPOL_b, o_cmd_ready=1, no earlier Pause cycle counted.

points.title: Pause lasting 16 or more cycles
points.condition: Pause cycle with at least 16 consecutive previous Pause cycles without handshake.

points.title: Long Pause of 64 or more cycles
points.condition: Pause cycle with at least 64 consecutive previous Pause cycles without handshake.

points.title: Pause exit by a command handshake
points.condition: Command handshake in a Pause cycle (o_cs_n=0, o_sclk at CPOL_b, o_cmd_ready=1).

points.title: Pause exit with i_cmd_last=1
points.condition: Pause-exit handshake with i_cmd_last=1.

points.title: Idle blocked cycle after o_cs_n rise
points.condition: o_cs_n=1, o_cmd_ready=0 and o_rsp_valid=0.

points.title: Burst start at first ready cycle of Idle
points.condition: Burst-start handshake in a cycle where o_cmd_ready was 0 in the previous cycle.

points.title: o_cs_n rises while a response byte is shown
points.condition: o_cs_n has just risen (previous cycle low) and o_rsp_valid=1.

points.title: Response byte becomes valid
points.condition: o_rsp_valid=1 in this cycle and 0 in the previous cycle.

points.title: Response taken in its first valid cycle
points.condition: o_rsp_valid=1 and i_rsp_ready=1 with o_rsp_valid=0 in the previous cycle.

points.title: Back-pressure on response for 3 or more cycles
points.condition: o_rsp_valid=1 and i_rsp_ready=0 after at least 3 consecutive such cycles.

points.title: Long response back-pressure of 32 or more cycles
points.condition: o_rsp_valid=1 and i_rsp_ready=0 after at least 32 consecutive such cycles.

points.title: Command blocked by response back-pressure
points.condition: i_cmd_valid=1, o_cmd_ready=0, o_rsp_valid=1 after at least 8 consecutive back-pressure cycles.

points.title: Response popped and another byte still valid
points.condition: o_rsp_valid=1 in the cycle after a response handshake (held byte released or simultaneous load).

points.title: Command handshake right after response taken
points.condition: Command handshake in the cycle after an o_rsp_valid and i_rsp_ready handshake.

points.title: Response shown during Pause or Trail
points.condition: o_cs_n=0, o_sclk at CPOL_b, o_cmd_ready=0 and o_rsp_valid=1.

points.title: First edge after reset release ready
points.condition: First clock edge with i_rst_n=1 after reset, with o_cmd_ready=1, o_cs_n=1 and o_rsp_valid=0.

points.title: Command handshake at first edge after reset
points.condition: Command handshake at the first edge after reset release.

points.title: Reset during Transfer or Trail
points.condition: First edge after reset release where the last pre-reset state had o_cs_n=0 and o_cmd_ready=0.

points.title: Reset during Pause
points.condition: First edge after reset release where the last pre-reset state was Pause (o_cs_n=0, o_sclk at CPOL_b, o_cmd_ready=1).

points.title: Reset during Idle gap
points.condition: First edge after reset release where the last pre-reset state had o_cs_n=1, o_cmd_ready=0 and o_rsp_valid=0.

points.title: Reset with a response byte shown or held
points.condition: First edge after reset release where the last pre-reset state had o_rsp_valid=1.

points.title: Burst start after long Idle
points.condition: Burst-start handshake with o_cs_n high for at least 32 cycles.
